description: Réparations de bris sur le réseau d'eau potable is a dataset listed in City of Montréal open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Montréal. La Ville de Montréal recueillit des données de réparations effectuées sur le réseau d'eau potable. Le nombre de réparations effectuées constitue un bon indicateur de l'état structural du réseau d'eau potable et permet d'identifier des segments de conduites problématiques de ce réseau. Coverage: Montréal. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Montréal. Its tags are Aqueduc, Arceau, Bris, Conduite, Infrastructure. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-02-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-montreal-portal.
